verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack shows none. The MCP server serves external LLM coding assistants rather than generating insights inside Unleash. Impact-metric safeguards and the stale-flag dashboard are rule-based or threshold-based features, not AI-generated suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
